title: UI refinements batch 1 (page gap, collapsible presets sidebar, AppCore bar occlusion)

decisions.text: Scope & process: 3 independent items -> 3 phases. Per-step atomic commits (step-id prefixed, Co-Authored-By); NO push; phase-boundary pauses; vue-tsc + bun green for UI steps. Item 3 commits in the AppCore repo; the re-synced AppMain.exe in MindWave stays gitignored (not committed).

Gap removal: zero the OUTER page padding (the <page>__inner wrapper) on all in-scope pages so the central block is flush with the window; inter-panel gaps stay (only padding -> 0, keep gap). Applies to base rule + responsive media-query overrides.

Presets sidebar collapse: reuse the Tracks-panel pattern -- filesPanelOpen ref persisted to localStorage; sidebar toggled via plain v-if (matching the Tracks panel, which has no animated transition) and removed from flow when closed. Default OPEN. REVISED (owner 2026-07-01): the gap between the files panel and the player must be 5px -- same as the Tracks panel's __content gap (replacing audio-page__inner gap:16px).

REVISED (owner 2026-07-01): toggle in the TOP-LEVEL menu bar (audio-page__tabs-bar), LEFT of the 'Плеер' tab (audio.playerTab), icon folder, label audio.filesTab (ru 'Файлы' / en 'Files'), aria-expanded/controls, active styling when open; toggles the shared filesPanelOpen. Top-level placement fits the shared presets sidebar (used by both Плеер and Редактор tabs). Not the player-view submenu.

AppCore fix: in updateBar hide the bar when the main window is NOT the foreground app (occluded/behind other windows) in addition to when minimized; show when the app returns to foreground. Detect via GetForegroundWindow + GetAncestor(GA_ROOTOWNER) identity, counting the bar (WS_EX_NOACTIVATE) as app-active.

Owner addition 2026-07-01: Start-button edge offset. After RF1.1 the embedded gnaural schedule toolbar (output-section--schedule, padding 0) leaves the Start button flush to the window edge. Give the schedule toolbar horizontal padding 16px (app standard unit ~= top-menu inset) so the Start button matches the top menu's edge offset; canvas stays full-bleed. Standalone + spectrogram toolbars already at 16px.
Owner addition 2026-07-01: files-panel close button. Add a close (x) button to the files panel header mirroring the Tracks panel header (q-btn flat round dense icon=close -> closeFilesPanel).

Owner addition 2026-07-01 (APPROVED, go): show the spectrum immediately on clicking an audio file. Today the spectrogram data (wavAudioBuffer) is only decoded on playback start (ensureLocalAudioReady), so on mere selection spectrogramBuffer=null and the tab shows 'no spectrogram'. Fix: export ensureLocalAudioReady from the audio store; in AudioPage handleSelectedPathChange, on a non-autoplay selection of a LOCAL audio file (wav/flac) set activeContentTab=player + activePlayerViewTab=spectrogram and trigger ensureLocalAudioReady(path, kind) to decode + populate the buffer without starting playback. SCOPE: wav/flac only; .gnaural keeps the schedule view (rendering a gnaural to WAV for its spectrum is out of scope for this item).

steps.title: Plan & ledger
steps.verify: ledger JSON parses; dependsOn DAG acyclic; plan + ledger committed
evidence: Grounded in code: item1 = per-page <page>__inner padding:16px (SettingsPage .settings-page__inner, LogArchivePage .archive-page__inner, LogPage, AudioPage .audio-page__inner, BodyMonitor 3 pages); MainLayout q-page-container adds no padding. item2 = AudioPage audio-page__sidebar always-visible; mirror GnauralScheduleView trackPanelOpen/localStorage/transition/toggle; player menu = activePlayerViewTab tabs (main='Воспроизведение', spectrogram). item3 = AppBar.pas updateBar hides only on IsIconic; bar is WS_EX_TOPMOST; rebuild via build/win_x64/build_app.bat, re-sync via server/sync-appcore-launcher.ps1.
DAG acyclic: RF0.1 -> RF0.2 -> {RF1.1, RF2.1, RF3.1} (three independent phases).

steps.title: Approval gate (RF-D2/RF-D4/RF-D5)
steps.verify: owner confirms RF-D2 (padding->0, keep inter-panel gaps), RF-D4 (toggle button left of Плеер), RF-D5 (foreground-based hide). PAUSE before Phase 1.
evidence: Owner approved ('go') after RF-D4 revised to the top-level menu (left of 'Плеер'). RF-D2/RF-D3/RF-D5 accepted as drafted.

steps.title: Zero outer page padding (all screens)
steps.verify: <page>__inner padding set to 0 (base + media queries) on all in-scope pages; inter-panel gap kept; vue-tsc clean; content flush with window edge (visual owner check)
evidence: Zeroed outer padding on __inner wrappers (base + ≤768/960 media queries), keeping inter-panel gap: MindWaveCore SettingsPage (.settings-page__inner), LogArchivePage (.archive-page__inner). GnauralCore AudioPage (.audio-page__inner, keeps gap:16px).
Dropped the Quasar `padding` prop on q-page for the pages that used it (no __inner wrapper): MindWaveCore LogPage; BodyMonitorCore MonitoringPage, AlphaRelaxationPage, CalibrationPage.
Verify: `bun run typecheck` (vue-tsc --noEmit) in MindWaveCore/ui passed clean. Changes span 3 repos -> one RF1.1 commit each (MindWaveCore, GnauralCore, BodyMonitorCore).

steps.title: Collapsible presets sidebar + 'Файлы'/'Files' toggle
steps.verify: filesPanelOpen (localStorage-persisted) toggles the presets sidebar via plain v-if (matching Tracks); files<->player gap = 5px (same as Tracks); 'Файлы'/'Files' toggle (folder icon, aria) sits left of the 'Плеер' tab in the top-level menu bar; audio.filesTab (+ show/hide aria) added to en/ru; vue-tsc + bun green
evidence: AudioPage.vue: sidebar wrapped in `v-if="filesPanelOpen"` (id=audio-page-sidebar) — plain v-if toggle matching the Tracks panel; filesPanelOpen ref loaded from + persisted to localStorage key mindwave-audio-files-panel-open (default open); toggleFilesPanel().
Added a folder/'Файлы' q-btn toggle in the top-level audio-page__tabs-bar, LEFT of the <q-tabs> (Плеер/Редактор), with aria-expanded/aria-controls + active styling (audio-page__files-toggle--active).
Set audio-page__inner gap 16px -> 5px (files<->player spacing == Tracks panel __content gap:5px).
i18n: added audio.filesTab/filesShow/filesHide to GnauralCore en.json + ru.json (Files/Файлы).
Verify: vue-tsc --noEmit clean (MindWaveCore/ui); GnauralCore bun test = 56 pass / 0 fail; i18n JSON parses.

steps.title: Start-button edge offset + files-panel close button
steps.verify: embedded schedule toolbar has 16px horizontal padding so the Start button matches the top menu edge offset (RF-D6); files panel header has a Tracks-style close (x) button -> closeFilesPanel (RF-D7); vue-tsc + bun green
evidence: RF-D6: added `padding: 0 16px` to .gnaural-schedule-view__toolbar (only used embedded in AudioPage) so the Start/transport controls (and right-side actions) are inset 16px from the card/window edge, matching the top menu; canvas row stays full-bleed. Standalone (output-section--main) + spectrogram (output-section--spectrogram) toolbars already carry 16px.

RF-D7: files panel header (AudioPage sidebar first q-card-section) restructured to audio-page__sidebar-header (flex space-between) with a close q-btn (flat round dense, icon=close, aria=filesHide) -> closeFilesPanel(), mirroring the Tracks panel header.
Verify: vue-tsc --noEmit clean; GnauralCore bun test 56 pass / 0 fail.

steps.title: Show spectrum immediately on audio-file click
steps.verify: clicking a wav/flac preset (without playing) decodes it and shows its spectrum: activeContentTab=player, activePlayerViewTab=spectrogram, SpectrogramView renders (spectrogramBuffer populated via ensureLocalAudioReady); .gnaural keeps the schedule view; vue-tsc + bun green
evidence: audio.ts: exported ensureLocalAudioReady from the store return.

AudioPage handleSelectedPathChange: after selectPath, when the selected path is a local audio file (isLocalAudioFileKind(nextFileKind)) -> activeContentTab='player' + activePlayerViewTab='spectrogram'; for non-autoplay selection also `void audio.ensureLocalAudioReady(path, nextFileKind)` to decode + populate spectrogramBuffer without starting playback (autoplay path still decodes via startLocalPlayback). .gnaural untouched -> keeps the schedule view.
Verify: vue-tsc --noEmit clean; GnauralCore bun test 56 pass / 0 fail. Visual gate (click a wav/flac -> spectrum appears without pressing play) left to owner.

steps.title: AppCore control-bar occlusion fix
steps.verify: updateBar hides the bar when the main window is not foreground (behind other apps) + when minimized; shows when app returns to foreground; AppCore build_app.bat succeeds; AppMain.exe re-synced; committed in the AppCore repo
evidence: AppBar.pas: added mainWindowIsActive() (GetForegroundWindow + GetAncestor(fg, GA_ROOTOWNER)=gMainWnd, also matching gMainWnd/gBarWnd; bar is WS_EX_NOACTIVATE so it never steals foreground). updateBar guard now hides the bar on `IsIconic OR not mainWindowIsActive OR not GetWindowRect` -> the TOPMOST bar no longer floats over other apps when MindWave is backgrounded; the 30ms timer re-shows it (SWP_SHOWWINDOW) when the app returns to foreground.

Built via build/win_x64/build_app.bat -> 'Build successful' (confirms GetAncestor/GA_ROOTOWNER available in the FPC Windows unit). Re-synced AppMain.exe (+libwebview.dll) into MindWaveCore/server via sync-appcore-launcher.ps1; both remain gitignored (git check-ignore confirms) and are NOT staged in MindWave.
Committed in the AppCore repo (source only). Manual/visual gate (send window behind another app -> bar hides; bring forward -> bar shows) left for the owner.
NOTE: build_app.bat also deploys AppMain.exe/libwebview.dll to Games/KKLeftRight/server (existing script behavior, unrelated to MindWave).

Decisions RF-D1..RF-D5 drafted; next = RF0.2 approval gate.
Owner clarified: the 'Файлы'/'Files' toggle goes in the TOP-LEVEL menu bar, left of the 'Плеер' tab (not the player-view submenu). RF-D4 + RF2.1 verify updated. Still at approval gate RF0.2.
Owner approved ('go'). Decisions RF-D2..RF-D5 locked. Proceeding to Phase 1.

Owner additions: (RF-D6) schedule toolbar padding 0 16px -> Start button no longer flush, matches top-menu edge offset (canvas stays full-bleed); (RF-D7) Tracks-style close (x) button added to the files panel header -> closeFilesPanel. vue-tsc clean; GnauralCore bun 56/0. UI-refinements batch 1 COMPLETE. RF1.1 (page gap removed on all screens), RF2.1 (collapsible presets sidebar + Files toggle, 5px gap), RF2.2 (Start-button offset + files close button), RF3.1 (AppCore bar hides when backgrounded). Manual/visual acceptance (layout + window occlusion) left to owner.

REOPENED for a new owner item (RF-D8): show the spectrum immediately on clicking an audio file (wav/flac) by decoding on selection + switching to the spectrogram view, without requiring playback. Grounded: spectrogramBuffer is populated only by ensureLocalAudioReady (today play-only); SpectrogramView is worker/file-path based and gated on spectrogramBuffer!=null. Awaiting owner 'go'.

Clicking a wav/flac preset now shows its spectrum immediately: exported ensureLocalAudioReady; AudioPage switches to player+spectrogram and decodes on non-autoplay selection (no playback needed). .gnaural keeps the schedule view. vue-tsc clean; GnauralCore bun 56/0.
UI-refinements plan COMPLETE again (RF1.1, RF2.1, RF2.2, RF3.1, RF4.1). Visual/manual acceptance left to owner.
